revisions.reason: Review 20261127 GM collision-event fold: handler 395 also runs the Game Maker 8 collision-event pass (ids 19/20/21, its three loop heads) natively in $gmf_cev, reached through $gmf_run, which writes no EIP and returns fall-back or a resume address (a loop head or the function's epilogue). The handler's only change is the fallback's first instruction for 19-21 (mov eax,[abs32] / mov eax,[esp+8]: EAX and the +5/+4 resume) and the cmp-byte fallback narrowed to 15/16. EIP writes unchanged (same six sites, one $eip = $entry with $branch_end); no callback frame, invocation identity preserved. General callback ownership remains pending.
